name: D13-17 EVENT_FLOW_CLOCK_V0_1
commonGuards: Market reaction timestamp never changes legal effective timestamp.
Legal effective timestamp never proves economic flow has realized.
Later full/block-inclusive trading data cannot backfill an 18:10 partial-version decision.
Foreign-investor net trading is not automatically FX conversion or cross-border balance-of-payments flow.
Monthly/quarterly data may describe regime/context but cannot be aligned as same-day flow.
Current revised history cannot be treated as real-time vintage without source-vintage evidence.
